company.name: Ascent Partners
company.shortDescription: A business set-up advisory firm, with the sole aim of facilitating entrepreneurs to build and grow their businesses worldwide.
company.description:
Ascent Partners is a business set-up advisory firm, located in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. We are a team of dynamic and accomplished industry experts, with the sole aim of facilitating entrepreneurs to build and grow their businesses in the United Arab Emirates and worldwide.

With a combined experience of 70+ years, our group of expert consultants ensure to provide reliable and unparalleled guidance throughout all strategic phases of a business set-up, ranging from company formation and expansion to market floatation and exit.

Ascent Partners offers personalized services for entrepreneurs and high net-worth individuals to enjoy the benefits of running a business as well as living in the United Arab Emirates.
